data.note: Edge HTML nav on the production domain is bot-challenged for datacenter/CI clients; a per-route `edge.shape` of `challenged`/`unreachable` is informational only. A `served` shape confirms real content; an `error` shape (genuine 5xx, not a challenge) while content + liveness are healthy is the one apex-HTML failure the probe now pages on (S179 shape). Availability is judged by origin content (Pages, unchallenged) + edge liveness (a JSON path). S275: `workerIngest` (OPTIONS /v/rum expecting 204) verifies the ROUTE worker is the real build — a 405 means requests fall through to Pages, i.e. a wrong/stale worker was deployed (the 07-03 clobber that silently killed telemetry ingest for 9 days). Counts as edge-degraded.

honesty.note: commitsBehind and ageHours are recorded at probe time against the then-current repo tip, not recomputed against a moving HEAD. An unobserved state means no probe has run — it is never reported as current.

data.source: Derived from live repo evidence at build time. Each control links the file or build gate that proves it; an unresolvable control downgrades to unverified rather than being asserted.

controls.label: Security headers
controls.detail: Cloudflare Worker applies CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, and Referrer-Policy plus related browser hardening.

controls.label: CSP discipline
controls.detail: Evidence not resolvable at build time (config/csp-policy.mjs + scripts/csp-audit.mjs); reported unverified rather than asserted.

controls.label: RUM privacy
controls.detail: RUM is route-level and privacy-minimized: ux events pass an allowlisted names-only Set (RUM_UX_EVENTS + cleanRumUxEvent) — no user IDs, query strings, or free text are ever stored.

controls.label: Production Worker route provenance
controls.detail: Evidence not resolvable at build time (api/worker-route-provenance.json); reported unverified rather than asserted.

controls.label: Supply-chain scan
controls.detail: Evidence not resolvable at build time (scripts/verify-supply-chain.mjs); reported unverified rather than asserted.

controls.label: Obelisk adoption
controls.detail: Identity wrapper exists; Obelisk posture is phase-4-public-app-migrated (passkey-first migration waits on later Obelisk phases).

controls.label: Responsible disclosure
controls.detail: Reports route to mailto:security@vaultsparkstudios.com via the published security.txt policy.

controls.label: Trusted Types
controls.detail: First-party DOM sinks covered by tt-default-policy.js (report-only; enforce flip is founder-gated pending real-device verify). lint-tt-policies.mjs in build:check keeps all named policies file-specific.
